explanation: The Apache-2.0 text is unchanged, with the template copyright line left as-is. Appended are third-party sections. MIT covers Keras, cnpy and ONNX (ONNX is only named as MIT). BSD-3-Clause covers the Google Protocol Buffers files. Apache 2.0 is named for OpenCSV, Aeron, TensorFlow, Ansj and Kuromoji. The "All rights reserved" lines are copyright lines placed next to permissive grants, so they reserve nothing, and every license is on the allowed list.
